messages:
alex: Quick sync — proposing a 60m design review for the multi-model routing work (API + SDK + Console UX). Need to lock a time and confirm pre-read owners. Top goals: surface API contract changes, SDK ergonomics, and Console rollout flow.

alex: Proposed slots (PT): Tue 11:00-12:00, Wed 09:00-10:00, or Wed 16:00-17:00. Prefer Tue if folks can make it. Please add your availability.

maya: Tue 11 works for me. I can present the API contract and go through the open API gaps.

sam: Wed 09 better for me (timezone). If we do Tue 11 I can only join for first 30m.

jordan: Wed 16 is okay on my end. I volunteer to walk through the Console UX mockups and the proposed rollout steps.

riley: I can make Tue 11 but might be 5–10 min late. I’ll own SDK demo + compatibility matrix.

alex: Looks like Tue 11 has a majority (maya, riley, alex) but sam partial. Jordan prefers Wed. Options: 1) Tue 11 and record + follow-up with sam, or 2) pick Wed 16 to capture Console folks. Thoughts?

maya: Leaning Tue 11 to unblock API decisions quicker. If sam can't make entire time we can record and assign action items.

sam: Tue 11 okay, I’ll join for first 30 and leave an async remark. If there are specific SDK questions plz ping me beforehand.

alex: Cool — finalizing Tue 11 then. Agenda draft below. Add items or reorder.

alex: AGENDA (60m):
1) 5m — quick context & goals (alex)
2) 20m — API contract walkthrough + open questions (maya)
3) 15m — SDK ergonomics & migration plan (riley)
4) 15m — Console UX & rollout flow (jordan)
5) 5m — decisions, owners, next steps (alex)

riley: Adding a short demo of the SDK code snippet — will include perf/compat notes.

alex: PRE-READ checklist I'm asking everyone to complete before the meeting — put docs/PRs in thread. Please mark "ready" or note blockers.

alex: Pre-read checklist (paste into your PR comment as you complete):
```
- Read RFC: https://redwood.ai/rfcs/mm-router (esp. sections 2.1, 3.2)
- API: skim /openapi.yaml and list any breaking/unclear fields
- SDK: run local smoke with example app (./scripts/smoke-sdk.sh) and note errors
- Console: review mockups (Figma link) and flag rollout concerns
- Add short note in the PR: what you want decided vs. deferred
```

maya: RFC link added to meeting doc. I’ll tag specific API questions inline.

riley: Smoke script ran, found one type mismatch in the kwargs. Will open a tiny PR and mark it ready.

jordan: Figma updated with latest modal flows; added comments where we need telemetry hooks.

sam: I left an async note on SDK thread re: backwards compat. Won’t block the meeting.

alex: Who's taking notes? I can rotate to recording + action items but would prefer someone capture owners. @maya or @jordan volunteer?

maya: I can take notes this time.

alex: Thanks. I'm creating the calendar invite for Tue 11 PT and adding the meeting doc + recording link placeholder.

ci-bot: Reminder: meeting created "Design Review: Multi-model Router" Tue 11:00 PT — calendar invite sent to participants.

riley: One more thing — can we add a short checklist item for testing with Dedicated and Private configs? Small infra differences could affect API surface.

alex: Good call. Adding: "Verify behavior on Dedicated/Private deployments" to pre-read.

alex: If no other items, please drop your final notes/PR links by EOD Mon so presenters can incorporate.

sam: Will do. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

jordan: See you Tue 11.

maya: Thanks — will prep slides and callouts.

alex: Closing thread — invite sent, agenda in doc, pre-read checklist above.
